# YCB scanned asset sources and attribution

Source: https://ycb-benchmarks.s3.amazonaws.com/index.html

Data license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).
License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Attribution: YCB Object and Model Set — Berk Calli, Arjun Singh, Aaron Walsman, Siddhartha Srinivasa, Pieter Abbeel, Aaron M. Dollar. Scans were downloaded from the UC Berkeley / Google model column of the official YCB page.

SOURCE_INDEX.html preserves the source page and its license statement. sources.json records every download URL, archive SHA-256 and size. Original archives, OBJ, MTL and PNG files are retained.

Project modifications: conversion from OBJ to USD; rigid orientation correction for selected tools; translation of the canonical origin; uniform scene-specific scale and placement; UV coordinates and image textures preserved. Mass, friction and material parameters are not calibrated to the scanned physical objects.

Scanned product markings are retained as part of the original texture. Asset use does not imply endorsement or validation of a benchmark task.
